## English

Name WxPusher for what it is, and document configuration.

- WxPusher is a third-party push provider, not a WeChat API. Every "WeChat push"
  label, log line and README mention now uses the service name (with a clarifying
  note where useful).
- Both READMEs gain a Configuration section covering how to edit `config.toml`
  from each interface.

## 中文

明确 WxPusher 的定位，并补充配置说明。

- WxPusher 是第三方推送服务商，并非微信官方接口。所有「微信推送」措辞（界面标签、日志、README）改用服务名，必要时附澄清说明。
- 两份 README 均新增「配置」章节，说明如何在各界面形态下编辑 `config.toml`。
